progression.narrative: The performance opens on D4 and dwells most on D in Mokhalef. The line peaks at F4 (345.3 Hz) at 1:27.6. It closes on D4, not the tonic (D4 → D4 → D4 → E4 → D4 → D4).

flags: tonic Fs set in the catalog (Segah's finalis, about 178.8 Hz (8 of the suite's 20 gushe-ha end there, including the daramad). Mokhalef's finalis is the 6th above (Farhat 1990, p. 54). The vote picked that 6th (D). Inference, not yet by ear); the runs' vote favoured 292.7 Hz (Dk)
